reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000491 (the melody read from 000491a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Emily D. (Mrs. J. G.) Wilson's dates (1865–1942) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Wilson_Emily (Emily Divine Wilson, Mrs. J. G. Wilson, b. 24 May 1865, d. 23 June 1942); https://hymnary.org/tune/heaven_wilson credits HEAVEN (1898) to her; CCEH's page gives only the year 1898.
